content.title: Tiger Woods’ girlfriend Vanessa Trump and daughter Kai were not in car at time of rollover accident
content.text: TIGER Woods’ girlfriend, Vanessa Trump, and her daughter Kai Trump were not in the car during the rollover crash in Florida on Friday. The golfing legend, 50, was involved in a two-car rollover crash in Jupiter Island, Florida, an area north of Palm Beach. Sign up for the Sport newsletter Thank you! Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump confirmed their relationship in 2025Credit: Instagram / @tigerwoods Vanessa Trump is the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr., whom she shares five kids with, including KaiCredit: Getty Vanessa and Kai were not involved in the crash Two vehicles were involved in the crash, including a black SUV that was seen on its side. Vanessa and her daughter Kai were not in the car at the time of the crash, sources told the New York Post. Vanessa and Woods went public with their relationship in 2025, and the couple was recently seen packing on some PDA in a recent tournament. Vanessa is the ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr. The pair shares five children, including Kai, who is set to join the University of Miami golf team. One person was in stable condition after the crash while another refused to be transported to the hospital, police said. Officials confirmed there were no injuries. President Donald Trump spoke out about the crash on Friday while calling Woods a “very close friend of mine.” “I feel so badly. He’s got some difficulty. There was an accident, and that’s all I know,” Trump told reporters. Most read in Sport “Very close friend of mine. He’s an amazing person. Amazing man. But, some difficulty,” the president said. “I don’t want to talk about it.” Tiger Woods' car wrecks Tiger Woods, the 50-year-old golf star, was involved in a rollover crash Friday. Here are other crashes Woods has been involved in. November 2009: Windermere, Florida On Thanksgiving night, Woods crashed a Cadillac Escalade into a fire hydrant and then a tree He suffered facial lacerations and was briefly hospitalized May 2017: Jupiter, Florida Police found Woods asleep at the wheel of his running Mercedes-Benz, which had two flat tires and a broken bumper Woods attributed the state to an “unexpected reaction to prescribed medications” after back surgery He pleaded guilty to reckless driving and entered a diversion program. Toxicology reports later showed five different drugs in his system (THC, Vicodin, Dilaudid, Xanax, and Ambien) February 2021: Rancho Palos Verdes, California Woods was involved in a high-speed, single-vehicle rollover crash in a Genesis GV80 SUV Investigators determined he was traveling above 80 mph in a 45-mph zone Woods suffered multiple injuries, particularly to his right leg and ankle Source Woods has since been charged with driving under the influence after allegedly rear-ending a pickup truck, police confirmed on Friday. He crashed into the back of the other car at a high-rate of speed, police said. Police confirmed that the golf star showed signs of impairment and was able to crawl out of the passenger side of his car, which had rolled over. Woods has been involved in several car wrecks over the years, including one five years ago that left him seriously injured and fearing he would lose his leg. In 2009, Woods had another crash in Florida, where he was knocked unconscious and his then-wife, model Elin Nordegren, saved him by smashing his car window with a golf club. Friday’s accident comes after Trump hinted that Woods would not play in this year’s Masters on April 9, where the golf star was hoping to make a comeback. While Woods has not played in the PGA Tour since 2024, he had competed in the TGL finals earlier this week, only for his team to lose 9-2. Vanessa and Kai were seen cheering him on from the crowd.
